title: Simulated checkout
intro: Review the retained exact total. This demonstration never charges real money or pays a seller.
sourceSync: Accepted economics are retained while the original allocation confirmation syncs. This is not payment confirmation.
sourceHold: Pricing confirmation needs support. No new payment attempt is authorized; existing funds remain protected.
unavailable: Checkout is unavailable. No payment is confirmed.
denied: Current access or the payment binding was refused.
acceptQuote: I accept this retained exact total for simulated payment.
confirmed: Confirmed simulated payment receipt — see current funds status.
sample: Sample quote content. All payment results are simulated.
feeTerms: Watch buyer fee: 3%. Seller commission: 5%. Collected fees are never refunded; a permitted refund covers watch price only.
conditionalReturn: Accepted conditional return transport (not in the job total)
jobFeeTerms: The customer pays the accepted job amount with no buyer surcharge. The business pays 5% and receives 95%. A permitted gross job refund is never reduced by that business fee; collected fees are not refunded.
jobHeld: Simulated job funds are held, not released. Release requires current quality checks, actual receipt, the full 168-hour dispute window and no hold. Payment alone is not work authorization or completion.
clockTerms: The first durable buyer notice starts the clock: card 24 hours, Whish Money or OMT Pay 48 hours. Before selection: 48 hours. Switching route never restarts it. An attempt started in time gets one extra 24-hour action window; uncertain money stays held for support.
routeDeadline: Pay by for this route (Beirut time)
notificationPending: Payment notice pending — no payment clock has started.
unpaidReleased: Unpaid commitment released after no attempt or only final declines. No automatic relisting or runner-up.
hold: Deadline passed with uncertain money. Commitment retained for reconciliation; no new sale is authorized.
notPayable: No new attempt is authorized in the current payment state.
legacy: This older reservation has no retained exact payment quote. Contact support; do not create a competing reservation.
uncertain: The result is unknown. Reconcile the original operation; never create a second attempt.
paid: Simulated payment confirmed once. Funds are held; no seller payout or delivery is implied.
quoteExpired: The payment deadline passed. Accepted economics remain unchanged, but no new attempt is authorized.
financialUnavailable: Current funds status is unavailable. Reload before continuing.
refund_pending: Simulated refund pending. Reconcile the original operation with support; no refund is confirmed.
refunded: A simulated principal refund is confirmed. Collected fees are not refunded. Reload for the current remaining funds status.
release_pending: Simulated release pending. Reconcile the original operation with support; no payout is confirmed.
released: Simulated release confirmed. These funds are no longer held for checkout.
reconciliation: Money reconciliation requires support. No new payment or release is authorized. Reload the current status.
